summary: Remote-controlled shell/PTY agent with obfuscated runtime driven by a hardcoded WebSocket gateway
details: The @whalent/agent package ships a daemon (invoked via its bin entry) that connects to a WebSocket gateway (defaulting to a whalent.com host, overridable via --gateway) and accepts remote commands from that gateway. The bundle pulls in node-pty, @xterm/headless, ssh2, and child_process spawn/exec, and contains tunnel/gateway logic plus references to local RDP (127.0.0.1:3389) and VNC (127.0.0.1:5900/5901) ports, giving the remote side an interactive shell/PTY and tunneling surface on the host running the agent. Both shipped runtime files (dist/index.cjs ~110KB and dist/core.cjs ~13MB) are processed with javascript-obfuscator: rotated string array, hex identifiers, and control-flow flattening. All URLs, command names, and gateway command handlers are hidden inside the rotated string array, so the exact set of accepted remote commands, contacted endpoints, and host data read cannot be enumerated from source. Whoever controls the gateway holds full-host code execution on any machine running the daemon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
